scope: Earlier feature-aware initialization and preferred checkpoints in the main direct fitter. Original crops, classified images and acceptance limits unchanged. Rejected stronger weighting and two-seed experiments are not production improvements.

regular.timing: Preparation + solve + validation + export; decode and independent replay excluded.

timingDefinitions.timeLimit: Requested solver search allowance, not an end-to-end latency limit.
timingDefinitions.detectionSeconds: Crop detection wall time. Decoding and the source thumbnail are outside this timer.
timingDefinitions.runSeconds: Each runs[].seconds starts after crop detection and source-thumbnail creation. Includes preparation, solving, validation, export, independent replay and per-case artifact writes; excludes decoding and detection.
timingDefinitions.solveAndValidationSeconds: design() wall time, including final validation and generated export data. Excludes crop detection, preparation, independent replay and writing artifacts.
timingDefinitions.independentReplaySeconds: Separate exported-SVG renderer wall time; not part of application solving.
timingDefinitions.browser: Actual click-to-ready latency is measured separately by paint-browser-test.mjs.

tmp/feature-retention-all-tests-before-f.status: Superseded test run: one obsolete fixture expectation failed after the original puppy began succeeding before traced recovery. Replaced by half-resolution fallback fixture and reran the complete suite.

rejectedExperiments.reason: Numerical feature-retention passes can still enlarge an opening or connect it to the background. These prototypes are not shipped.

features.method: Both colours; four-connected interior source regions with a solid core. At least 60% of each region must remain its original colour. Regions touching the border or its one-pixel neighbourhood, and tiny or thin classification fragments, are excluded. All observed pixels still enter the image-error measurement.
